environment: isolated Chromium; in-memory Store; synthetic Obsidian/Markdown renderer

checks.name: emphasis masking follows question scope while code and stored text stay intact
hiding cloze reveals view text without revealing the back, allowing a grade or writing data
showing cloze restores masking with the same question and stored source
a temporary emphasis peek keeps explicit cloze and grading concealed
show answer remains the independent gate for grading
real drawing input and text feedback attach to one completed review and keep raw cloze
completed history renders saved feedback and drawing while hiding initialization audits
selected saved excerpt text is wrapped through the Store API
selecting the inner text cancels a saved plain cloze
cloze controls leave both unsaved draft text and saved source untouched
saved note text has the same wrap and unwrap control
review copy defaults to all content and image masks
no-deck enrollment opens a picker and creating a deck binds the learning set without implicit membership
selected copy parts and masks enroll with independent identity without changing the source
explicitly enrolled cards show persistent deck-name badges
editing the copied image mask leaves all source masks intact
explicit source refresh applies selected note and masks while keeping omitted title and excerpt
deck review first opens a read-only due-card browser before the explicit question-rating mode gate
the deck picker starts its isolated due queue and shows the selected deck identity
completed future-due cards remain deck members while the due start action becomes unavailable
all-card browsing still includes a future-due member without opening grading controls
the deck browser favorite action persists on the card without adding a review
browser editing returns to the same card and does not create a review
previous and next navigate persistent membership including both future and due cards
browser filters intersect favorite, tag, color and rating while retaining future members
manual review-question editing changes the projected face while leaving source title, excerpt and note intact
batch question extraction preserves an existing manual override and sets the other cards
native pre-AQ browsing has its separate 1188 by 679 white card, 20px text, Prev/Next footer and no scoring
native reference scoring uses the measured full white card, top counter and four equal bottom controls
native Note Card editor retains the 520 by 560 floating template and full-width bottom format bar
native formatting controls update the selected excerpt and persist card typography through the existing save path
Markdown preview renders the saved emphasis without rewriting the excerpt
the native pen control inserts a real drawn image into the note and persists it
